locale.description: BCP-47 locale for this initiative (e.g. en-US, fr-CA)

unitIncrements.description: unit of billing increments for this initiative

updatedAt.description: date and time this initiative was last updated

name.description: a name that identifies this initiative for the user

userId.description: the userId of the user to whom this initiative belongs

isLaurelCreatedNotModifiable.description: indicates this initiative was created by Laurel and cannot be modified or deleted except for unitIncrements

activityId.description: activity's id, for the new activity it should be null or undefined

fromSuggestions.description: whether this activity source was added from suggestions

fromThemes.description: whether this activity source was added from themes

startedAt.description: date and time this activity started, if set, it will be used to update or create the activity. it should be provided when creating a new activity

stoppedAt.description: date and time this activity stopped, if set, it will be used to update or create the activity. it should be provided when creating a new activity

title.description: activity's title, if set, it will be used to update or create the activity. it should be provided when creating a new activity

detail.description: activity's detail, if set, it will be used to update or create the activity

percentage.description: percentage of the source activity/entry duration to allocate

durationSeconds.description: fixed duration in seconds to allocate
